{
  "up": [
    "Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles",
    "From molecule_dictionary md",
    "Join activities on md.molregno = activities.molregno",
    "Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "Join target_dictionary td on assays.tid = td.tid",
    "Filter td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5619'",
    "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'",
    "Join compound_structures cs on md.molregno = cs.molregno",
    "Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles",
    "Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles",
    "Limit 1000000"
  ]
}
